notes: The wintty shader gallery. Each entry is a Shadertoy-style GLSL fragment shader (mainImage) that wintty compiles to HLSL via zioshade at runtime. The uniform contract is src/renderer/shaders/shadertoy_prefix.glsl in the repo root. Verify the whole corpus with: just gallery-verify (see tools/gallery in the repo). cursor_warp is excluded pending a zioshade fix (locals assigned inside a conditional block and read after are emitted as undef reads; DXC rejects with "Instructions should not read uninitialized value").

shaders.name: Cursor tail
shaders.description: A smooth trailing ribbon follows the cursor between cells.
shaders.author: Sahaj Bhatt

shaders.name: Cursor sweep
shaders.description: A sweeping highlight glides across the cursor row.
shaders.author: Sahaj Bhatt

shaders.name: Cursor ripple
shaders.description: A water ripple radiates from the cursor when it jumps.
shaders.author: Sahaj Bhatt

shaders.name: Cursor rectangle ripple
shaders.description: Ripple variant that keeps the selection rectangle crisp.
shaders.author: Sahaj Bhatt

shaders.name: Sonic boom cursor
shaders.description: An expanding shockwave marks each cursor jump.
shaders.author: Sahaj Bhatt

shaders.name: Rectangle boom cursor
shaders.description: Shockwave variant around the whole cursor rectangle.
shaders.author: Sahaj Bhatt

shaders.name: Cursor teleport

shaders.name: Lightning strike
shaders.description: A jagged forked bolt strikes from the top edge onto the cursor with an impact flash.
shaders.author: wintty project

shaders.name: Scanline

shaders.author: zoitrok

shaders.name: Pixels

shaders.author: zoitrok

shaders.name: CRT

shaders.author: wintty

shaders.name: Text glow
shaders.description: A soft bloom around bright text. Subtle and static.
shaders.author: wintty

shaders.name: Snowfall

shaders.author: wintty

shaders.name: Aurora
shaders.description: A slow aurora glowing through the terminal background.

shaders.name: Passthrough (diagnostic)
shaders.description: Shows iChannel0 untouched. If the screen is black or missing text, content is not reaching the shader.

shaders.name: Interference
shaders.description: Fallout-style CRT interference: a rolling signal band, twitching rows, static grain, and rare line tears. Fires constantly; no cursor action needed.
shaders.author: wintty project
